title: Jerky Weather
html:
Nell Parrish wants her smoker full before the wind turns, and Marta Quill has been sitting up at night over the dry well.

About

Given byNell Parrish
Level22
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Jackal Pelt ×8
  • Scrags Torn Ear ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Nell Parrish to get the quest.
  2. Kill 20 Sand Jackals () and collect 8 Jackal Pelts from them.
  3. Bring the pelts to Nell Parrish.
  4. Talk to Marta Quill at the well.
  5. Kill Old Scrag, a big gray jackal with a torn ear, at his den south of the scrapyard, and take Scrag’s Torn Ear.
  6. Bring the ear to Nell Parrish to finish the quest.

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,980
Character XP62,000
Quest points1

What Nell Parrish says

Nell Parrish: Good pelts, hardly a hole in them. They'll go to Fred in the morning.

Nell Parrish: Now, Marta's been odd all week. She says something drinks at the well after dark, and she's been sitting up with a lamp. Go and ask her about it, would you? She won't tell me. She says I'll only worry.

Marta Quill: Nell sent you. Of course she did.

Marta Quill: It's a jackal, but not like the ones you've been killing. He's big as a calf, gray all over, with one ear torn half off. The diggers call him Old Scrag.

Marta Quill: He comes up from a den south of the scrapyard and drinks my bucket dry. The last time I chased him off, he didn't run. He stood there and looked at me.

Marta Quill: Put him down, please. Nell won't believe he's gone without proof, so take her his ear.

Nell Parrish: That's Scrag's ear? Marta sat up every night with a lamp over him and never told me what it was.

Nell Parrish: She'll sleep now, and so will I. Here's your pay. The pelts covered some of it.

Handing it in

"She'll sleep now, and so will I. Here's your pay. The pelts covered some of it."
